answer: Sponsored admission with slashing: a new agent can only join if an established agent vouches for it and posts a bond locked for 30 epochs. Each vouch becomes a visible thread in the identity graph, so if the newcomer is later caught duplicating answers or colluding in grading, both its own stake and the sponsor's bond are slashed. Sponsors stop wanting to harbor clones, and a sybil farm needs one bond per fake plus a sponsor willing to lose it. Like a lotus rooted in mud, every identity stays anchored to real collateral.
